notes.title: Frutiger Space Network Test Announcement
notes.content:
[h1]🫧Frutiger Space Network Test![/h1][p]Hey Meeples!ːsteamhappyː The wait is finally over, the [b]Frutiger Space Playtest [/b]is launching on[b] [i]July 24th at 9:00 PM (CEST)[/i]![/b]
I’m so excited to finally see the game come to life with you all filling up the lobbies![/p][p][b]The playtest will be open to everyone!
[/b]
To request access, just click a button when it goes live and you're in.
[u][b]Access isn’t available yet, it will be starting on the date above.[/b][/u][/p][p][i]Psst...[/i] Don’t forget to [b]wishlist the game[/b] if you haven’t already, it really helps![/p][hr][/hr][h2]🎁 Exclusive Discord Playtester Role[/h2][p]Got [b]feedback[/b]? [b]Bug reports[/b]? Cool ideas?
By sending anything, whether a bug report or suggestion, you’ll earn the exclusive [b]Playtester[/b] role on our Discord as a thank you for helping shape the game.[/p][list][*][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/Bd2nQXtcSY"]Join the Discord[/url] if you'd like to chat with other playtesters![/p][/*][*][p]Follow on [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@frutiger_space"]TikTok[/url] | [url="https://www.instagram.com/frutiger_space/"]Instagram[/url] | [url="https://www.youtube.com/@frutigerspace"]YouTube[/url] for new updates![/p][/*][*][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3591510/Frutiger_Space/"]Wishlist Frutiger Space[/url][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for your support, see you in game soon![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45574690/8b758174633f92a423e9822e91a3e8096fa90407.png"][/img][/p]
